title: Global form of the nearby-open quasi-section: a curve through x inside U quasi-finite over the base at x
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> S locally of finite type with S locally Noetherian, x in X a closed point of its fibre X_s, U an open containing a specialization x' of x with f(x') != s, the lemma produces a closed subscheme Z through x which is quasi-finite over S at x and meets U at a point specializing to x with image different from s. The retained proof is a fully written reduction to the local-algebra sibling (lemma-quasi-finite-quasi-section-meeting-nearby-open, already collected): set A = O_{S,s}, B = O_{X,x} (essentially of finite type over A), V the inverse image of U in Spec(B); the hypothesis supplies a point of V not mapping to the closed point of Spec(A), so the local lemma applies to give a prime q over a non-maximal prime with A -> B/q the localization of a quasi-finite map; taking z the image of q in X and Z the reduced closure of {z} gives O_{Z,x} = B/q, hence quasi-finiteness at x, and the specialization and image conditions transfer verbatim. Retained author proof at lines 15006-15023.
